visualCharacteristics: A horizontal in-page anchor bar under the hero that becomes fixed at the top when scrolled past and underlines the link of the section in view; below 768px it collapses to a label with a chevron toggle.
contentPattern: One cell: a paragraph with the mobile "navigate to" label and a ul of links to #ids, where each id matches a section carrying a Section Metadata id.
usage: Use on long pages to give visitors a sticky jump menu to the main sections of the page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse on any long page with anchor-targeted sections; add the start class to align the links to the left inside the padded container.
